meta.v2: Themes bw-light/bw-dark, glass, neumorphic, density, motion modes and canvas tokens are v2 additions designed from the brief, not from the code.

tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Page background behind every view (zinc-50 / zinc-950).

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Cards, widgets, dialogs, menus, fields.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Segmented-control tracks, hover rows, icon tiles, skeletons.

tokens.name: surface-canvas
tokens.usage: The drag-and-drop canvas / form-builder board behind placed blocks.

tokens.name: line-100
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers inside cards (header rules, list dividers). In Black & White they reach 3:1 so rows stay separable without shade.

tokens.name: line-200
tokens.usage: Borders of fields, cards, menus, widget outlines at rest.

tokens.name: line-300
tokens.usage: Editing-mode widget borders, dashed drop placeholders, secondary-button borders. Decorative (1.5:1): state is always also shown by the focus ring, shadow or a dashed style.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on every surface token.

tokens.name: ink-label
tokens.usage: Form labels and secondary emphasis on surface-100 / surface-200 / neu-ground.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Hints, captions, widget titles, table meta on surface-000 / surface-100. Not on neu-ground: use ink-label there.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders and the muted 'No' in the wordmark. Decorative only — never sole carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: brand-solid
tokens.usage: Active preset's solid: primary buttons, active nav, sidebar mark, focus ring. 'default' preset (zinc-900 / white).

tokens.name: brand-solid-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand-solid.

tokens.name: brand-ocean
tokens.usage: Ocean preset solid (blue-600 / blue-500). Becomes brand-solid when the firm picks Ocean.

tokens.name: brand-ocean-ink
tokens.usage: Text on brand-ocean.

tokens.name: brand-forest
tokens.usage: Forest preset solid (emerald-700 / emerald-500).

tokens.name: brand-forest-ink
tokens.usage: Text on brand-forest.

tokens.name: brand-sunset
tokens.usage: Sunset preset solid (amber-700 / amber-500).

tokens.name: brand-sunset-ink
tokens.usage: Text on brand-sunset.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px outline, 2px offset, on every focusable control. Follows the preset.

tokens.name: in
tokens.usage: Series 1 / money in / receipts: chart fills, kind badges, the In segment. Pair with the arrow icon. Light value darkened from the app's #2a78d6 to reach 4.7:1 on surface-100 and 4.5:1 on surface-000.

tokens.name: out
tokens.usage: Series 2 / money out / payments. Orange vs blue is the colour-blind-safe pair; B&W themes add a hatch. Fills and icons only (3.2:1 on white) — never body text.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive deltas and saved states. Always with a check icon or word. Source green-600 is 3.3:1 on white: kept exact, use for icons and 18px+ figures, not small text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions, errors, the strike-mark. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger-surface
tokens.usage: Error panels and danger-button hover ground. danger text on it is 4.4:1 in light (source values, kept) — set error copy at 500 weight.

tokens.name: info-surface
tokens.usage: Info chips such as 'Includes sample data' (blue-100 / blue-950).

tokens.name: info-ink
tokens.usage: Text on info-surface.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines and axis strokes.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dialog backdrop (blurred 4px in glass style).

tokens.name: glass-surface
tokens.usage: Glass style: translucent card fill over the canvas; always with 16px backdrop blur and glass-edge.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: Glass style: 1px card border catching light.

tokens.name: glass-tint
tokens.usage: Glass style: soft wash painted behind the canvas so blur has something to refract. Keep it a flat tint, never a gradient across the UI.

tokens.name: neu-ground
tokens.usage: Neumorphic style: the single ground every raised/inset element shares. Text: ink / ink-label only.

tokens.name: neu-light
tokens.usage: Neumorphic highlight (top-left) shadow colour.

tokens.name: neu-dark
tokens.usage: Neumorphic shade (bottom-right) shadow colour.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Record receipts and payments per student or staff member.
styles.usage: Default UI text: table cells, menu items, fields, buttons (buttons at 500).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, widget titles, button text.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Segmented-control inner padding (table density toggle).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Track padding, icon-button padding.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Compact row block padding; label-to-field gap; icon-button padding in widget headers.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Button block padding; small gaps.

tokens.name: space-2.5
tokens.usage: Comfortable row block padding; ghost-button inline padding; list row padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Field inline padding; form row gap; menu item inline padding.

tokens.name: space-3.5
tokens.usage: Primary-button inline padding; widget body gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Table cell inline padding; compact card padding; widget header bottom margin.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Comfortable widget/card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dialog body padding and header inline padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section gaps on dashboards.

tokens.name: control-h-compact
tokens.usage: Compact density: buttons, fields, segmented items.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Comfortable density (default): buttons and fields — 20px line + 2×8px.

tokens.name: row-compact
tokens.usage: Compact density table row block padding (py-1.5).

tokens.name: row-comfortable
tokens.usage: Comfortable density table row block padding (py-2.5).

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area on touch / mobile for drag handles and icon buttons.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chart legend keys, drag-handle hover.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Segments inside a track; icon buttons in widget headers.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, menus, tooltips, the R monogram tile.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Icon tiles, palette tiles, empty-state boxes, chart frames.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Dashboard widgets, dialogs, error panels.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, kind badges, chips, progress bars.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Fields and widgets at rest (Tailwind shadow-xs).

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, the selected segment, widgets in editing mode.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Menus, chart tooltips, popovers.

tokens.name: shadow-2xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the widget being dragged (with a 1deg tilt).

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Glass style cards.

tokens.name: shadow-neu-raised
tokens.usage: Neumorphic style: cards and buttons at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-neu-inset
tokens.usage: Neumorphic style: fields, segmented tracks, pressed buttons.

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: Flat motion mode and prefers-reduced-motion: every transition.

tokens.name: duration-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and press feedback. Must land under 100ms or it reads as lag.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: State changes: colour, border, shadow, selected segment. Never over 150ms.

tokens.name: duration-exit
tokens.usage: Exits and dismissals (menu, dialog, toast out) — about 40% faster than the entrance.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Hover lift on primary CTAs (-2px).

tokens.name: duration-enter
tokens.usage: Entrances: reveals, dialogs, sheets, a dropped widget settling. Ease-out, never past 300ms.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Attention only (a toast or notification arriving, the hero strike-mark). Never for entrances.

tokens.name: duration-stagger
tokens.usage: Delay between siblings in a reveal group: 30ms blurs into one block, 100ms crawls.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled primary and danger buttons.

tokens.name: opacity-placeholder
tokens.usage: Drop placeholder left behind by a dragged widget.

tokens.name: opacity-dim
tokens.usage: Non-hovered chart series while another is hovered.
